meta.title: Network Engineer Assistant (network-command-kb)
meta.description: A DeepSeek Harness plugin: a switch/router/firewall/hypervisor command knowledge base with 13 vendors and 98 documents (Huawei, H3C, Ruijie, DPtech, Cisco IOS/NX-OS, Juniper Junos, Arista EOS, Fortinet FortiOS, ZTE ZXR10, VyOS, MikroTik RouterOS, Proxmox VE), a loadable network-command-kb skill, the 网络工程师助手 agent preset, and a native MikroTik WinBox terminal tool (mt_winbox_exec, read-only by default).
